title: treesight extraction output
description: What the model writes after reading one session from where the ledger last stopped. Every new node and open item carries its message id and a verbatim quote. It can only add nodes, add open items, propose closing open items that already have an id, or say which of its new items a later record already settled. scripts/ledger.py checks it, assigns stable ids and appends it to the ledger.

through.description: The last message this extraction read.

settled.description: Open items of this output that a later record in the digest's header already settled: sessions drawn before this one although they come after it could not close them.

gist.description: One sentence on what the session worked on and where it ended, in the language of its prompts: its summary on the project page.

others.description: One-sentence summaries of other sessions of the project, each written from the short excerpt `show others` printed; only the sessions it listed may be named.

notes.description: Anything the model was unsure about, for the user.

session.description: The first 8 characters of the session id, as show others printed it.

overturns.description: A node this one withdraws or corrects: an id from the ledger or a ref in this output.

blocked_by.description: Another open item that has to happen first: an id from the ledger or a ref in this output.

close.description: A proposal to close an open item that already has an id. sure false, or status expired, goes to the user to confirm instead of closing.

settled.description: A close of a new open item by a later record (a node of another session, or a close made in one), named by its id. The ledger copies that record's quote. sure false, or status expired, goes to the user to confirm.
